findings.title: Hermes draft contract is contradictory and currently wrong
findings.problem: The design requires auto-only and openUrl-only success, but the actual controller accepts guided mode and returns draftId, expiresAt, mode, topic, meta, and note.
findings.fix: Use z.literal('auto').default('auto'), reject guided, return exactly { openUrl }, and add assertions for budget, truncation, zero generate/promotion calls, and non-persisted key material.

findings.title: Candidate-only isolation is not an enforceable write boundary
findings.problem: The design does not thread a run context through direct active writes in final-write, auto-audit, audit persistence, regeneration loops, and PresentationService.save.
findings.fix: Require an IntegrityRunContext and one ArtifactStore for every write; reject candidate-only writes outside the run root and test every target-original path for zero writes.

findings.title: Typed compare and metric contracts have ambiguous count semantics
findings.problem: ComparisonItem leftText/rightText does not define whether four items are pairs or total items, and MetricItem cannot represent preserved legacy text with missing value without an empty field.
findings.fix: Choose an explicit column-item or pair model, define deterministic legacy mapping, and use a discriminated metric/omission union with no empty required values.

findings.title: Logical/custom canvas transform is underspecified
findings.problem: No transform origin, scale policy, rounding, or application contract is defined, while actual HTML, fallback, editor, and export paths use different dimensions. Proposed node metadata is also absent from the schema.
findings.fix: Define a typed LogicalCanvasTransform with forward/inverse mappings and apply it everywhere; validate before transform and declare layout metrics metadata.

findings.title: Unverified status is not integrated into audit aggregation
findings.problem: The design introduces unverified without defining compatibility with existing passed/warn/fail/error and pass/warn/fail unions; current Chromium failure returns error.
findings.fix: Extend status types or add verificationStatus, map environment absence to unverified, aggregate required unverified as overall unverified/needs_review, and reject promotion/pass claims.

findings.title: Font fallback detection algorithm is unreliable and incomplete
findings.problem: CSS computed family does not prove the actual face used per glyph; the design lacks node sampling, weight matching, metric baselines, thresholds, and an API-unavailable algorithm.
findings.fix: Specify declared-family checks, representative glyph measurement, metric delta thresholds, explicit reasons/statuses, and unverified behavior when actual shaping cannot be proven.

findings.title: Editor save has no atomic HTML/Deck/identity transaction
findings.problem: The current editor and server save only HTML; the proposed DOM patch helper has no invocation, atomic commit, required-deletion gate, or behavior for manual nodes.
findings.fix: Define saveSlideWithIntegrity, map stable IDs, validate before commit, return 422 with reportPath while retaining unsaved state, and route editor/store/server/MCP saves through it.

findings.title: Not every export path uses the parity gate and Deck priority
findings.problem: The proposed helper is web-only, but MCP/server export directly sanitizes HTML; the compatibility wrapper can also silently return a mixed-source Deck with source=plan.
findings.fix: Enumerate all exporters and route them through one exportWithIntegrity adapter with per-slide provenance, parity rejection, and explicit HTML fallback downgrade.

findings.title: Required evidence events have no producer wiring or lifecycle
findings.problem: An event schema is listed, but producers, runId propagation, candidate log routing, and event-write failure behavior are unspecified; current audit writes active reports.
findings.fix: Provide a producer matrix for render, visual_validation, audit, and fix, pass run context everywhere, write candidate-only events, and make missing evidence unverified/needs_review with post-fix new hashes.

findings.title: Fallback provenance fields are absent from the declared Deck schema
findings.problem: The design requires source, geometryFallback, and parity downgrade metadata, but only top-level Deck.source exists and per-slide fields are undeclared.
findings.fix: Add backward-compatible per-slide integrity/provenance metadata or require every caller to carry a typed ExportResult rather than a bare Deck; test mixed-source serialization.
